create_timeseries: create a TimeSeries object with a start time, end time, and number of samples
get_sample_by_timestamp: get a Sample from a TimeSeries by querying it with a specific timestamp value
query_timeseries_properties: query the SampleCount, Window, DeltaTime, and MaximumFrequency properties of a TimeSeries object
simulate_timestamps: simulate shifted timestamps for a TimeSeries by calling SimulateTimestamps with an offset value
access_first_last_sample: access the FirstSample or LastSample property of a TimeSeries to get boundary samples
